def top_terms(text: str, limit: int = 5) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the most common words, tie-breaking alphabetically."""
    if limit < 1:
        return []
    counts = term_frequencies(text)
    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return ranked[:limit]
